prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit the provided website screenshot into a polished professional portfolio presentation image for Mostaql. This screenshot is the exact finished UI, not inspiration: preserve every pixel of the page content, all English text, logo, navbar, buttons and relative layout. Add only framing outside the original screenshot. Keep the entire screenshot visible, flat and front-facing with NO perspective and NO content crop. Enlarge the canvas to a landscape 16:10 format. Center the screenshot inside a refined rounded rectangular browser-style frame with a thin pale-blue border, small understated top strip with three subtle dots, a soft natural drop shadow, and generous outer padding. Outer background: elegant very dark navy-to-indigo gradient, subtle blue glow, understated thin blue perimeter rule, matching the existing website's blue palette. Make the screenshot fill about 86 percent of the canvas width, with all original details legible. Premium minimal case-study presentation. No new titles, slogans, captions, labels, badges, contact information, logos, devices, hands or other objects. Do not rewrite or re-render any screenshot typography. Output a single high-resolution finished image.
